source.title: Effects of SGLT2 Inhibitors on Clinical Outcomes, Symptoms, Functional Capacity, and Cardiac Remodeling in Heart Failure: A Comprehensive Systematic Review and Multidomain Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials

source_internal_consistency_findings.issue: The paper reports 11 RCTs and total n=23,812, but the N values printed in Table 1 sum to 23,999.
source_internal_consistency_findings.handling: Retained the source-reported total when describing the source, tagged dependent atoms, and recorded the arithmetic discrepancy here without inventing a corrected study total.

source_internal_consistency_findings.issue: Section 3.3 reports six large cardiovascular outcome trials with n=22,927. The six cited trials [19,24-28] have Table 1 sample sizes summing to 22,477.
source_internal_consistency_findings.handling: Preserved the source-reported denominator in the affected atoms and flagged the mismatch.

source_internal_consistency_findings.issue: The statistical methods call the random-effects model DerSimonian-Laird while also stating that between-study variance tau-squared was estimated by Paule-Mandel.
source_internal_consistency_findings.handling: Reported as a methods-description inconsistency; no estimator was silently substituted.

source_internal_consistency_findings.issue: Eligibility names approved SGLT2 inhibitors as dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, and canagliflozin, but SOLOIST-WHF with sotagliflozin is included. Later methods explicitly discuss sotagliflozin in sensitivity analysis.
source_internal_consistency_findings.handling: Reported as an eligibility-wording inconsistency; the source inclusion was not changed.

source_gaps: README(2).md was not available in the supplied project sources or connected Drive searches. This lower-precedence workflow-intent gap did not prevent execution of the governing domain model, sufficiency validator, and serialization schema.
The article-linked supplementary package was not present in the selected Drive materials folder.
extraction_limitations: This is a secondary-source meta-analysis. Individual-trial effects remain reports made by this review and are tagged secondary_reported_result when atomized. Primary-study atoms require direct extraction of the cited trial publications.
Atoms are machine-extracted and marked needs_review.
No source-internal arithmetic or methods inconsistency was silently repaired.
